a.text: You smell like rain and Bureau paperwork. The Sable is up the street on the right, under the red awning. They found a broker in the back.  Dead.  Like everything else around here.

c.text: Everyone and no one. Lowmarket stops looking at faces after dark.

lines.speaker: juno
lines.text: Hey, I'm looking for the Sable House.

lines.speaker: kit
lines.text: It's across the street with the red awning.  You can't miss it.
